_comment: Secret-free reference MCP config for Launch Control skills. Add personal servers with claude mcp add --scope user, or copy shared servers into a project .mcp.json. GitHub and Atlassian are authenticated remote integrations; use Claude Code /mcp to complete their user authentication. shadcn and chrome-devtools are local stdio servers launched with npx and do not use remote OAuth. Do NOT hardcode tokens here.

shadcn._used_by: component search for UI work in onboarded projects
